messages:
emily: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the weird cross-region TLS spike earlier today (09:40 UTC). Putting proposed fixes and owners here so we can track.

jordan: Thanks Emily. Short summary?

emily: Root cause appears to be a timing window where registrar DNS rotation (low TTL) coincided with a route-table change that temporarily directed traffic to a legacy backend without the updated SNI mapping. Result: many clients retried and some hit fallback pools, producing a retry-amplification loop.

lee: Do we have concrete evidence for the SNI mismatch? Packet/log samples?

ops-oncall: I sampled edge logs for 09:40:05 - 09:43:00. Observed TLS_ALERT=40 and mismatched SNI in ~34% of failures. Example: ```
[09:41:12] src=172.31.22.8 dst=lb-eu-02 TLS_ALERT=40 expected_sni=api.prod.v3 actual_sni=api.prod
[09:41:13] src=172.31.22.9 dst=lb-eu-02 TLS_ALERT=40 expected_sni=api.prod.v3 actual_sni=api.prod
```

emily: Timeline: deploy started 09:38, route-table apply 09:39, registrar rotation initiated 09:40. Overlap window ~09:40:00-09:42:30.

net-infra: Proposed mitigations: 
- Short: roll back the route-table reordering to stop traffic to legacy pool. Owner: jordan. ETA: 1.5h.
- Short: Add an SNI-aware health probe so pools with mismatched SNI are marked unhealthy. Owner: lee. ETA: EOD.
- Medium: Implement a registrar-rotation guard in the control plane: pause zone rotations for hostnames during active rollouts (configurable window). Owner: net-infra. ETA: 2 weeks.
- Medium: Add client-edge jitter and exponential backoff tuning to reduce retry amplification. Owner: ops-oncall. ETA: next sprint.
- Short: Create alert for 'cross-region SNI mismatch ratio' and tie to runbook. Owner: ops-oncall + emily. ETA: 24h.

emily: Draft action items (AI):
- AI-501: Roll back route-table reordering and verify traffic shifts off legacy pool (owner: jordan) - ETA 1.5h.
- AI-502: SNI health probe + heuristic to mark legacy pools unhealthy on repeated SNI mismatch (owner: lee) - ETA EOD.
- AI-503: Registrar rotation guard RFC + schedule (owner: net-infra) - ETA 2w.
- AI-504: Edge client retry backoff tuning + e2e test (owner: ops-oncall) - ETA next sprint.
- AI-505: Alert/dashboard for SNI mismatch and TLS handshake spikes (owner: emily / ops-oncall) - ETA 24h.

jordan: Taking AI-501. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot for out-of-band rollback.

deploy-bot: @jordan scheduled rollback deploy for 11:12 UTC. CI checks passed.

lee: Taking AI-502. I'll add probe in branch feat/sni-health and open PR with tests. Quick heuristic: mark pool UNHEALTHY if >3 SNI mismatches in 60s from same edge.

ops-oncall: Adding AI-505 to my queue. Will create a Grafana row and PagerDuty rule for 3x baseline TLS_alert_40 rate sustained for 5m across inter-region traffic.

net-infra: AI-503 note: registrar APIs vary by provider; we need a small orchestration lock that can gate rotations per-hostname for X seconds while a rollout is active. Drafting RFC now, will include migration plan for current hostnames.

emily: Verification checklist: 
1) rollback reduces retry rate and eliminates SNI mismatch volume (jordan)
2) SNI probe detects the issue in canary (lee)
3) alert fires on synthetic repro, low false positives (ops-oncall)
4) RFC published (net-infra)

jordan: Rollback done at 11:12, metrics: retry_rate 5.8% -> 0.8% within 4m. Pushing to incident dashboard.

lee: PR opened: https://git.redwood/netprobe/pull/278 (feat/sni-health). Tests pass in CI. Requesting review and a hotfix flag.

ops-oncall: Alert rule in staging, validated against replayed logs. Will promote once PR merged and probe enabled in staging.

emily: Do we need customer comms? No P0 external impact reported, a handful of retries for a small subset. Recommend internal note in ops digest and include action items in postmortem.

lee: Extra follow-up: will also add a short-term metric that tracks 'route_delta vs registrar_rotation' overlaps to catch timing windows in future. Owner: lee, ETA: 1w.

net-infra: RFC draft uploaded to docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/registrar-guard/rfc (WIP). Will ping for review.

ops-oncall: Scheduling weekly 'cross-region retry' sync for next 3 weeks to monitor for regressions. Owner: emily.

emily: I'll update the incident tracker with AIs and mark this thread pinned. Please reply here when each AI is complete.

jordan: Marked AI-501 done in tracker.

lee: Merging PR after one more review, will notify here.

emily: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the canonical follow-up.
